name: Hacking Array
desc: [Effect] Continuously hacks and seizes control of enemy unmanned ships (Remnant automated ships, drone ships).\n[How it works] Each equipped ship locks one target in range and accumulates hack progress (multiple ships on the same target combine, effect x 2^(n/(n+1))) -> at 100% the target is paralyzed for 5 seconds (capture transition) -> switches to your side and fights normally -> joins your fleet after the battle. Successful capture spreads progress to other hackable targets in 2000 range, then triggers hack cooldown.\n[Values] Range 2600; base rate 2%/sec (faster with larger ECM difference, slower on bigger targets: frigate > destroyer > cruiser > capital); spread +15% x size-multiplier ratio; cooldown 5s x size multiplier / locking ships.
short: Continuously hacks and seizes control of enemy unmanned ships.

name: Boarding Pod
desc: [Effect] Fighter pods board and seize control of enemy manned ships (this hullmod is mounted on the Boarding Pod fighter wing).\n[How it works] Only fighters with CR above 0 can count a touch: touching the target (within 120) counts one boarding hit -> ammo and CR are emptied and it returns to the mothership for resupply -> sorties again (CR restored) -> when the required number of hits is reached, the target is paralyzed for 10 seconds (capture transition) -> switches to your side -> joins your fleet after the battle. Targeting prioritizes the player's locked target (R key), max engagement range 4000.\n[Values] Touch range 120 / engage 4000; hits needed: frigate 25, destroyer 38, cruiser 63, capital 100; max speed 300; refit time 6.
short: Fighters board enemy manned ships to seize control.

name: Boarding Driver Core
desc: [Effect] Drives electronic-interference malfunction rolls for all ongoing boarding operations (0 ordnance cost; only links with the Boarding Pod wing).\n[How it works] Every 10 seconds each ship being boarded is checked: once boarding progress passes 40%, a roll is made - on success one random malfunction triggers: engines flame out (cannot move) / weapons lock (cannot fire) / shields fail (cannot raise), with status text and effects; past 70% progress, a critical malfunction triggers (double duration, 5% hull structure loss, no hull loss when current structure is at or below 15%).\n[Values] Check interval 10s; chance = 20% + (progress - 40%) x 1%; engine/shield fault 5s, weapon fault 12s, critical x2.
